Chapter 1312 - 1: Yin-Yang Twin Life Flower

Chapter 1312: Chapter 1: Yin-Yang Twin Life Flower

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in a desolate void, where numerous tiny runes continuously condensed before him.

The invisible timeline unfolded towards the future in his sight.

"Is this the feeling of a time life form? Gazing into the future?"

Lin Yuan felt a sense of joy.

He finally understood why time life forms were so rare and seldom made appearances.

Firstly, because they are scarce.

Even in a perfect-breath dimension space like the Source World, the time life forms that eventually emerge are not many.

This limitation in quantity makes time life forms rare, thus making appearances and actions infrequent.

Secondly, for time life forms, there is simply no need to make appearances or take action; they can directly view the various future timelines.

Most of the time, apart from cultivating in seclusion, time life forms watch more and further future timelines.

Unless they see resources and opportunities beneficial to themselves, they wouldn’t act or appear meaninglessly.

"It’s a pity that I’m ultimately not a true time life form. The farthest timeline I can see is within a hundred thousand years, and the number of timelines I can watch isn’t many either."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Through the Rune Dao, he achieved what only time life forms can, but it could only be considered a ’castrated version.’

To be precise, Lin Yuan’s ability to see his future timeline was achieved through ’clever’ means.

Normal time life forms can view future timelines because of their sufficiently high life essence.

If the future is likened to a labyrinth, the height at which the time life form resides overlooks the labyrinth, allowing them to naturally see each path inside ahead of time, whether it’s a dead end and what obstacles may occur.

And Lin Yuan? His life essence hasn’t reached such a height to overlook the labyrinth. The reason he’s able to view the future is by briefly seeing through the labyrinth’s walls.

His grasp and perception of future timelines cannot be compared to that of true time life forms.

Yet, even so, Lin Yuan remains deeply engrossed in watching his individual future timelines.

"Hmm?"

"This timeline shows an extremely obscure and distorted image thirty thousand years later. Is it contact with other time life forms?"

Lin Yuan pondered.

Even true time life forms would face significant resistance when viewing the future timelines of other time life forms of the same level.

Lin Yuan, not yet being a time life form, finds that whenever his future timeline involves time life forms, it becomes immensely obscure, blurred, and distorted.

After passing this period, the timeline image gradually became clear and normal again.

"It seems I’m getting along well with that time life form."

Lin Yuan speculated, continuing to observe the distant future timeline.

Soon.

The future timeline reached eighty thousand years later.

Here, as Lin Yuan continued to observe even further into the future, it became gradually more challenging.

On this timeline, Lin Yuan’s progression to the thirteenth stage was relatively delayed, estimated at becoming a time life form in about twenty thousand years.

By eighty thousand years later, having become a time life form, Lin Yuan had long started exploring the mysterious dimensional crevices beyond the Chaos Void.

Dimensional crevices are regions between vast dimensional spaces, fraught with danger, where only colossal beings like time life forms have the privilege to roam.

Underneath time life forms, local life forms in dimensional crevices might have some survival abilities.

As for life nurtured within dimensional spaces, generally, they cannot survive long in the crevices due to its exceedingly harsh environment.

In the eighty-eighth-thousandth year, while exploring a mysterious dimensional crevice, Lin Yuan discovered an unusual flower at a remote spot, simultaneously imbued with Yin Yang Power and perfectly fused.

"The Yin Yang Two-Life Flower?"

Lin Yuan closely examined this timeline and learned the name of this extraordinary flower.

"This Yin Yang Two-Life Flower, perfectly fused with Yin Yang Power, is of great help for me to reach the third level of the Chaos Taiji Dao."

Lin Yuan felt a slight stir in his heart.

Eighty-eight thousand years later, Lin Yuan’s Chaos Taiji Dao had long reached the third level, so even if he found this Yin Yang Two-Life Flower then, it wouldn’t be of much use at that time.

But right now, Lin Yuan’s Chaos Taiji Dao had yet to reach the third level.

Moreover, in all the future timelines Lin Yuan has observed thus far, his Chaos Taiji Dao crossed into the third level almost always post becoming a time life form.

The leap from the second to the third level of Chaos Taiji Dao is a qualitative transformation of one’s Chaos evolution path, not only requiring insight but also enough accumulation, costing tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years to grind.

"Let’s look at a new timeline."

Lin Yuan immediately began to reexamine the new future timelines.

In this timeline, Lin Yuan decided at once to send an incarnation to the location of the Yin Yang Two-Life Flower to collect this rare wonder in advance.

"Success."

Lin Yuan continued to watch this timeline; with the power of the Yin Yang Two-Life Flower, he finally managed to elevate his Chaos Taiji Dao to the third level before stepping into the thirteenth stage.

This is the only timeline Lin Yuan has observed so far where, before becoming a time life form, his Chaos Taiji Dao crossed into the third level.

"The Yin Yang Two-Life Flower."

Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up, determined to obtain this rare treasure.

Moments later.

Lin Yuan dispatched the Taiji Primordial Spirit to the dimensional crevice, heading towards the location shown in the future timeline of the Yin Yang Two-Life Flower.

"There shouldn’t be any problems."

Lin Yuan watched the Taiji Primordial Spirit leave and continued to observe several new future timelines. Once he was sure his Primordial Spirit had a great chance to retrieve the Yin Yang Two-Life Flower, he nodded slightly.
